DEPARTMENT OF COMPUTER SCIENCE · WILLIAM & MARY

Efficient, interpretable and rigorously evaluated AI for software engineering.

The AURA Lab, founded in Fall 2024, works on the cost, transparency and evaluation of AI for software engineering: making code models cheap enough to deploy, legible enough to trust, and measured by methods that hold up. Directed by Antonio Mastropaolo.

U10 PAPERS

Neurosymbolic reasoning & interpretability

Neural models joined to grammars, types and program analysis, with explanations pitched at what a developer actually reads.
R18 PAPERS

Reliability & honest evaluation

Causal and counterfactual analysis, and the study of automated judges — where they hold up and where they mislead.

Agents across the software lifecycle

Task-aware and multi-agent automation, from issue triage to review, measured end to end rather than per snippet.

Software & artifacts

04 · 1 TOOL · 10 REPLICATION PACKAGES

Research software developed in the lab, and the replication package published with each empirical paper.

ACTIVE · BETA · v0.1.0
AuraPulse-S

A native macOS client for the lab's GPU server: live telemetry for four NVIDIA L40S cards, SLURM submission and queue monitoring, and a built-in SSH terminal. Credentials stay in the macOS Keychain. Free for William & Mary CS students.

PLATFORMmacOS 14+ · Apple Silicon
DOWNLOAD6.9 MB DMG
HARDWARE4 × NVIDIA L40S
ACCESSW&M CS account
